title: New automated guard: generated MCP inventory must never silently diverge from the governed authority doc again
summary: revu-mcp's lifecycleState was ACTIVE/REGISTERED in both the authority doc and a second hardcoded object in discover-mcp-estate.mjs, while no launcher actually exists in CapitalGlassRevu. Corrected both to PLANNED_SPOKE/PLANNED and added reconcile-registry-with-authority.mjs (npm run mcp:workspaces:reconcile-authority), which fails closed on drift. Adversarial self-testing found and fixed a bug comparing a nonexistent row.source field instead of row.repository.
retrievalQuestions: How does the MCP registry authority reconciliation guard detect drift between the authority doc and the generated inventory?
What was the revu-mcp registry drift and where was it corrected?
What bug did adversarial self-testing find in the first version of reconcile-registry-with-authority.mjs?

futureAgentInstructions.whenThisAppears: A future agent needs to trust the MCP estate's lifecycleState for any surface, or is adding a new generated/derived MCP artifact
doNot: Trust a generated/derived MCP inventory artifact (e.g. mcp-estate-inventory.json) as authority without cross-checking mcp-authority-registry-v1.json
Build a new reconciliation or drift guard without adversarially self-testing it (inject a known-bad state, confirm it actually fails closed) before trusting it
proveBeforeClaiming: npm run mcp:workspaces:reconcile-authority exits with DRIFT_DETECTED when a deliberately stale status is injected, and RECONCILED when the real state matches
The commit 0b389796e7f2d0fe7b75393a8213135648f72a91 is still local and unmerged on work/mcp-estate-remediation-v1
